items.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009
items.q: And Big Maybelle, I played with her for a couple of jobs.

ctx.x: Dick Hart and the Heartaches, that’s what they called themselves. And Big Maybelle, I played with her for a couple of jobs. And I mean you know, I mean that was the way to go. I mean that was actually, it was more or less my learning years playing with that kind of stuff. Because I always wanted to play bebop. That was my main goal. But there wasn’t that many gigs to get and I wasn’t all that really experienced to get those gigs yet, so I cut my teeth on playing with rhythm & blues bands for a while. And that was…
Henry, can you remember what some of those rhythm & blues gigs would have paid at the time?
